newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products - gasoline surges, gas oil steady.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - gasoline surges, gas oil steady.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Tuesday morning, gasoline surging on Monday NYMEX gains but gas oil dropping back after initial strength, dealers said.
Gasoline was up about $5 on Monday's close, after NYMEX gasoline futures closed up 2.29 cents a gallon.
"The U.S. is showing really good demand at the moment," one trader said.

A Eurograde barge traded at $220.00 fob ARA, and a regular barge at $213.00. Traders said the buyer was taking back shorts. October and November swaps were level at around $219, with December $15 lower.

Heating oil and diesel barges were mixed after initial Oct futures gains were wiped out. The withdrawal of Monday's dominant heating oil buyer pushed prompt offer premiums down 50 cents to Oct IPE +$8 fob ARA. However, tightness of low sulphur diesel pushed the market to Oct +$20 fob ARA, with some offers very much higher.
"I'm offering at +$25 at the moment," one trader said.
High sulphur fuel oil barge deals were all at $122.50, up about $2 on Monday's close.
"Avails are not great and a lot of people need (fuel) oil," one trader said.
